build_star_cfq_builder: build a StarCFQ dataset builder with configurable splits for random, blended, and compound divergence datasets
create_star_cfq_config: create a StarCFQConfig builder config specifying split archive path, split path, and compound divergence flag
generate_blended_split_configs: generate blended split builder configs for equal weighting and overweighting dataset combinations
generate_compound_divergence_configs: generate compound divergence builder configs for u-CFQ with varying divergence levels and random seeds
generate_single_pool_configs: generate single pool random split builder configs training and testing on the same pool
